title: Message/set reaction modification check uses sender-tagging not caller identity
close_reason:
Triage 2026-10-19 at 9fdbbbcf, OBSOLETE (3-skeptic check 3/3 upheld): The bead depends on two things that are no longer true at HEAD 9fdbbbcf.

(1) The `SenderId::Owner` sentinel no longer exists. Commit e8ad58d2 ("fix(chat)!: owner senderId is the accountId", Refs JMAP-405z.2) removed `jmap_chat_types::SenderId`. `Reaction.sender_id` is now `Id` (crate-jmap-chat-types/src/message.rs:317), documented as "The accountId for the owner's reaction, otherwise the reacting user's ChatContact.id". The check in crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:1235-1272 (Message/set update, the `reactions/{id}` pointer path) now reads `if existing.sender_id != account_id { bad.push(...) }` and rejects with `forbidden`.

(2) The spec has since settled the "account vs principal" question the bead's comment escalated, and it chose per-account (Path A). draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md:217 says: "The owner has no ChatContact: a client-facing reference to the owner carries the accountI
